title: SetHome100
description: Save your home locations and easily teleport to them.
body:
# 🏠 SetHome100

**SetHome100** is a modern and lightweight homes plugin made exclusively for **Paper** servers running **Minecraft 1.20.1+**.

Save multiple homes, teleport smoothly across dimensions, and enjoy a clean experience built for modern Minecraft servers without unnecessary bloat.

## ✨ Features

### 📍 Multiple Homes

Players can save up to **10 homes by default**, with the limit fully configurable in the config file.  
Every home stores the exact location, including coordinates, dimension, yaw, and pitch for precise teleportation.

### ⚡ Smooth Teleportation

Teleportation includes a configurable **3-second countdown** to keep gameplay balanced while still feeling fast and responsive.

SetHome100 supports teleportation across:
- 🌍 Overworld
- 🔥 Nether
- 🌌 End
- 🧩 Custom dimensions from other plugins/mods

No unsafe teleports, glitches, or broken locations.

### 🧠 Smart Tab Completion

You do not need to remember your home names anymore.

The built-in **Tab Completer** automatically suggests saved homes while typing commands, making navigation faster and more convenient.

```bash
/home <TAB>
```

### 🔊 Audio Feedback

Teleportation uses the classic **XP Orb Pickup** sound effect for a more satisfying experience.  
Sounds can be easily enabled or disabled in the configuration.

## 🛠️ Commands

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/sethome <home>` | Save your current location |
| `/home <home>` | Teleport to a saved home |
| `/delhome <home>` | Delete a saved home |

## ⚙️ Configuration

SetHome100 keeps configuration simple and clean.

```yml
# How many seconds the player will have to wait after starting the teleportation
teleport-countdown: 3

# Play sounds during teleportation
enable-sounds: true

# Maximum number of homes a player can set
max-homes: 10
```

## 🚀 Planned Features

SetHome100 is actively evolving with many planned improvements, including:

- ⚔️ Combat restrictions to prevent escaping PvP or death situations
- 🚶 Movement detection during teleport countdowns
- 🖥️ GUI-based home management
- 📜 `/homes` command for viewing all saved homes
- 🔒 Permission support and rank-based limits
- 🛠️ Continued optimization, bug fixes, and future version support
- 🌍 Open-source release planned on GitHub
